newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO raises annual dividend by 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO raises annual dividend by 20 percent.

text.p: MAPCO Inc. said on Tuesday it had raised its annual dividend to $1.20 a share from $1.00, before giving effect to a two-for-one stock split announced today.
A regular quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share, before giving effect to the split, was declared by the board, payable December 27, record December 9.

"The company anticipates returning between 20 percent and 30 percent of earnings to shareholders through dividends going forward," Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Philip Baxter said in a statement.
